qa_pair.question: What is the exact text of the shortest verse in the King James Bible (KJV), and which verse reference is it?

How many verses does Psalm 119 have in the King James Bible?

qa_pair.answer: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

qa_pair.answer: 9 books: Joshua, Judges, Job, Jeremiah, Joel, Jonah, John, James, Jude

qa_pair.question: What is the very last verse of the Bible (Revelation 22:21) in the King James Version?
qa_pair.answer: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
